definition: **Bronchiolitis 為累及細支氣管（bronchioles）和/或肺泡管的發炎或纖維化；CT 幾乎總能顯示異常，包括 centrilobular micronodules、bronchial wall thickening、bronchiolar dilatation、mosaic attenuation；infectious bronchiolitis 為最常見類型。**
keyPoints: 定義：累及 bronchioles 和/或 alveolar ducts 的 inflammation/fibrosis
name: Bronchiolitis Imaging
